'''Versella''' was a member of [[Lissar]] and [[Darrik]]'s family on [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. As one of the older cousins, she was responsible for ensuring that the young children made it to and from the [[Brentaal Commerce Academy]] on a daily basis.<ref name="IDC" />
